about: Hand-kept Israeli days that Hebcal does not carry. Merged into _calendar.json by scripts/calendar-sync.mjs — an edit here changes nothing until that script is run (the gate fails otherwise). Every entry needs a source a human checked. The quiet days are the owner’s list of 2026-09-29: memorial days, Yom Kippur and Tisha B’Av (NOT the minor fasts), election day and Rabin day, Shabbat and every chag. verifiedThrough is the date a human has checked this file to; the calendar is truncated there. See /israeli-calendar.
